teaser: The hallway outside the classroom has one light that won't stop flickering, and you are the one who notices first. Life path 3 is the number of The Creative; ESTJ is the Executive, the type built for order and structure. Cross the two and you get someone who turns a room's mood into an agenda — jokes landed at exactly the right pace, the sign-up sheet already circulating before the bell rings. The charm is real. So is the clipboard underneath it.
